BiblicalUsage: lónchē means a spear, and once is enough to see what it is doing. In John 19:34, "But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the spear is the proof of His death and the fountain of our life — blood and water came out, and the soldier's thrust settled it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
